status: Current-version interactive performance review; owner playtesting pending

architecture.population: One aggregate per connected ecoregion; no global tribe ledger
architecture.events: Independent seeded random dates, direct regional lookup, local neighbours, persistent O(log E) queue
architecture.affiliation_precision: 1% regional shares; finer local differences are procedural, not traces of every historical migrant
architecture.publication: Copy-on-write records; lazy full hash only when requested/saving
architecture.executor: Same Core simulation in shipped CoreCLR worker; committed regional binary deltas returned to managed player
architecture.streaming: Bounded calculation batches; completed update decoding overlaps the next calculation; pause stops at a committed boundary
architecture.display: 60Hz map redraw budget during fast simulation; gameplay display preferences restored afterward; Paleolithic Auto target20000 years/second
architecture.global_work: World generation/save/load, visible regional map summaries and rare bounded family-registry compaction scale with data, not ordinary entity handlers
architecture.maps: Cell-to-region GPU lookup built once; small regional palettes per layer
architecture.ecology: Broad climate/resource/forest state; local species derived from native realm, dated climate and resource stocks
architecture.local_detail: Deterministic camps, residents and itineraries generated on demand

limits: Measurements are this machine and fixture, not a universal throughput guarantee.
Regional rates remain approximate game priors; a performance repair is not complete historical calibration.
Local species suitability is derived, not an individually tracked global animal migration history.
Physical NPC camp integration remains separate; local candidates require terrain validation.
Old simulation saves are unsupported. Generate a new world.
